brief.topic: DeepSeek Harness E4 candidate-owned Provider failover plugins
brief.question: Which pinned DeepSeek Harness plugin repository, if any, provides a real model Provider selection/fallback/degradation contract suitable for ZWorkbench E4, rather than same-route retry or search-tool fallback?

criteria.question: What are the repository identity, revision, package identity, and compatibility/install contract?
Does the candidate select among at least two model Providers or provider routes and transition on an explicit Provider failure, instead of only retrying the same route?
Does the candidate expose durable or observable failure classification, selected/fallback Provider identity, degradation state, and fallback reason?
What credentials, network, subprocess, remote resource, lifecycle, and uninstall/exit responsibilities does the candidate introduce?
Is the candidate's maintenance, dependency, release, and configuration surface plausible for a personal developer or small team?
